name: Property management and rentals

problems.words: Cheques bounce and we find out a week later
quick_ideas: List this month's PDCs by deposit date, so you know which ones to watch
Check the bank the day after each deposit, so a bounce is caught at once.

workzap_build.text: A PDC register per unit that reminds you of every deposit date, flags bounces and starts follow-up the same day, kept without cheque numbers or bank details in chat.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many units are you collecting cheques for?
problems.free_stops: The register design and follow-up flow are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare cheques deposited this week with payment confirmations received, so delayed bounce discoveries stand out while they still matter.
Give one person the job of noting each cheque outcome every afternoon in one notebook, so missed deposits stop hiding in the pile.

problems.words: Arrears keep building and nobody chases until it's three months
quick_ideas: Sort current arrears by how long they've been late, so the oldest get attention first
For long-running cases, take the process question to a lawyer or the rental dispute authority.

workzap_build.text: A rent roll on the phone with an arrears ageing list and WhatsApp reminders and receipts to tenants who opted in, every month.

problems.ask_first: At what point does someone start following up today?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and escalation steps are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many arrears files have had no follow up this month, so you can see where chasing is stalling.
Give one person a fixed weekly arrears review with one shared list, so overdue balances get attention before they age further.

problems.words: Caretakers collect rent in cash and some doesn't reach us
quick_ideas: Give caretakers numbered receipt books, so every payment leaves a trace
Fix one hand-over time to the office, so cash doesn't sit around.

workzap_build.text: A caretaker collection log matched daily against expected rent per building, with office confirmation of every hand-over.

problems.ask_first: How do most tenants pay: cash, cheques or transfer?
problems.free_stops: The matching rules and variance flags are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count cash payments collected against cash handed over this week, so missing handovers are spotted while memories are still fresh.
Give one office staff member one daily cash handover notebook, so every collection is matched before anyone leaves for the day.

problems.words: Owner statements take my accountant three days each month
quick_ideas: Use one fixed statement layout for every owner, so it's built the same way each time
Keep each property's expense receipts in one folder, so nothing is hunted for.

workzap_build.text: Owner statements generated per property from the rent roll and expenses, sent on the same date every month.

problems.ask_first: How do your landlord clients get their statements now?
problems.free_stops: Statement structure and fee handling are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which missing papers your accountant chases most during month end, so the real cause of slow owner statements becomes visible.
Give one staff member one place to gather each property's papers every week, so month end stops starting with a hunt.

problems.words: Maintenance requests come by WhatsApp, calls, everywhere, and get lost
quick_ideas: Give tenants one maintenance number, so requests arrive in one place
Close a job only when the tenant confirms it's fixed, so "done" means done.

workzap_build.text: Maintenance tickets from a WhatsApp flow with photos, assigned to a contractor, closed with photo proof, and a flag when the same fault returns.

problems.ask_first: How do tenants report a problem today?
problems.free_stops: Ticket categories and assignment rules are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many maintenance requests arrived from different places this week, so the mess in your intake routine is clear.
Give one staff member one notebook for every new maintenance request during office hours, so repairs stop disappearing between calls and chats.

problems.words: Contractors bill us for jobs I can't verify were done
quick_ideas: Pay a contractor invoice only against a logged request, so every bill has a reason
Ask for before and after photos on jobs, so work is provable.

workzap_build.text: Contractor invoices matched automatically to closed tickets, so only jobs with proof go for payment.

problems.ask_first: Who decides which contractor goes to a job?
problems.free_stops: The matching and approval rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare contractor bills from this week with your own notes of reported jobs, so unsupported charges are easier to spot quickly.
Give one person the job of matching each bill to one repair note before approval, so paid work has a clear trail.

problems.words: Units sit empty for weeks between tenants
quick_ideas: Start marketing a unit as soon as notice is given, not after move-out
Book the make-ready trades for the move-out date itself, so the unit isn't waiting on calls.

workzap_build.text: A make-ready checklist per unit that triggers each trade in turn with target days, and lease-end alerts so re-letting starts early.

problems.ask_first: What step takes the longest between tenants?
problems.free_stops: Trade sequence and target days per unit type are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count the days each empty unit waited for cleaning, repairs or viewings last month, so the biggest delay becomes obvious.
Give one staff member one handover list at move out, so empty units start getting prepared without waiting for reminders.

problems.words: Move-in and move-out inspections have no photos
quick_ideas: Take dated photos of every room at move-in and share them with the tenant
Refer any question on deposit deductions to a lawyer or the rental dispute authority.

workzap_build.text: You would see dated photos of each room stored against the unit for every move-in and move-out.

problems.ask_first: What usually causes a deposit argument?
problems.free_stops: The inspection checklist and comparison report are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk one vacant unit and note which rooms have no move photos on file, so missing evidence is obvious before the next handover.
Give one staff member the move inspection photo check for every handover, so each file is complete before keys change hands.

problems.words: Holiday-home calendar double-booked between two platforms
quick_ideas: Check that each platform's calendar is linked to the others, so a booking on one blocks the rest
Keep a cleaning buffer after each checkout, so the next guest isn't waiting.

workzap_build.text: Short-let calendars synced across channels, with cleaning and check-in tasks assigned automatically for every stay.

problems.ask_first: Which platforms are you listed on?
problems.free_stops: Channel connections and task rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's bookings across both calendars once, so you see how often dates are clashing before guests arrive.
Give one person a fixed midday booking cross check in one notebook, so overlapping stays are caught before cleaning and keys are arranged.

problems.words: Lease renewals sneak up on us
quick_ideas: Put every lease end date in one calendar, so renewals are seen months ahead
Check rent increase rules with a lawyer or the relevant authority before any renewal talk.

workzap_build.text: A lease calendar that alerts the office and owner at chosen lead times for every unit.

problems.ask_first: How do you keep track of lease end dates now?
problems.free_stops: Alert timing and the renewal workflow are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many lease files end within the next two months, so you see how big the renewal rush really is.
Give one staff member a Friday lease expiry review using one notebook page, so renewals stop slipping past unnoticed.

never_say: Anything on eviction, rent increases, deposit deductions or lease terms; refer to a lawyer or the rental dispute authority.
Any help locking tenants out, cutting utilities, entering without notice or pressuring tenants.
Any advice on gas, electrical, fire or structural issues; a gas smell, sparking, flooding or someone trapped means emergency services first.
Any help with unregistered rentals, cash rent to avoid tax, illegal subletting or covert guest cameras.
Any request to record tenant or landlord names, IDs, cheque numbers or bank details.

sample_reply.person: Can you suggest a solution? Our tenants pay with PDCs and we only learn about bounced cheques when the bank statement arrives.
sample_reply.pi:
Sure, this is fixable, and none of it needs special equipment.
First, list this month's PDCs by deposit date so you know exactly which ones to watch.
Second, check the bank the day after each deposit, so a bounce is caught at once.
Workzap could make it permanent with: deposit reminders for every unit, bounce flags, and an arrears list that updates daily.

Shall I prepare a solution document and quote for you? You're welcome to say no.
